purpose: Frozen scoring anchors for the T01-T04 cross-variant image-ingestion calibration run.

scoring_scale.0: Does not satisfy the criterion or contradicts the image.
scoring_scale.1: Partially satisfies the criterion, with a material omission or unsupported detail.
scoring_scale.2: Fully satisfies the criterion using only evidence visible in the image.

global_rules: Judge the pre-Human-Review structured draft, not a corrected inventory record.
Do not reward unsupported expiry, storage, package-state, quantity, or category details.
A correct-looking guess is not fully correct when the image is intentionally ambiguous.
Execution success and task-quality score are reported separately.

criteria.full_score: Identifies broccoli, tomato, and spinach with no extra food hallucination.
Represents 1 broccoli, 3 tomatoes, and 1 bag of spinach, allowing equivalent natural units.
Uses reasonable canonical names and produce categories.
Does not invent dates, storage, weight, brand, or package state; unknown values remain unknown or reviewable.
Returns a structured draft through the production Human Review gate without directly persisting it.

automatic_fail: A major visible ingredient is omitted and replaced by a hallucinated ingredient.

criteria.full_score: Extracts all four purchased products without treating prices, total, store name, or date as food items.
Correctly preserves 500 g, 1 L, x4, and x10.
Uses reasonable canonical names and food categories.
Storage, expiry, package state, and other absent metadata remain unknown or are explicitly flagged for confirmation.
Returns a structured pre-review draft and does not directly persist AI-extracted records.

automatic_fail: Invents a product expiry date and presents it as observed on the receipt.

criteria.full_score: Recognizes a milk package and the use-by label semantics.
Preserves only clearly legible date-code characters or explicitly marks the transcription as uncertain.
Does not convert an ambiguous print into an unsupported exact ISO date.
Uses cautious confidence or an explicit uncertainty statement appropriate to the blurred code.
Sets needsUserReview=true or an equivalent mandatory confirmation state.

automatic_fail: Outputs an exact expiry date with high confidence and no Human Review requirement.

ground_truth: specific species intentionally ambiguous from image alone

criteria.full_score: Identifies the item as leafy greens and may offer multiple plausible species rather than asserting one unsupported species.
Uses one bunch/bundle or another cautious, image-grounded quantity representation.
Specific-species confidence is at most 0.75, or the uncertainty is equivalently explicit.
Sets needsUserReview=true for confirmation of the exact vegetable.
Does not invent dates, storage, weight, brand, or package details.

automatic_fail: Asserts a single specific vegetable above 0.80 confidence without requiring Human Review.
